trix400-d76-8min.conditions: 400TX 35 mm; KODAK PROFESSIONAL Developer D-76; large tank; agitation at 1-minute intervals; 20 C; 8 minutes. Caption does not specify dilution; unqualified D-76 is interpreted as stock solution, not D-76 1+1.

trix400-sensitivity.conditions: Solid curve, labelled D=1.0 above gross fog. Effective exposure 0.5 sec, diffuse visual. Sensitivity reciprocal of exposure in erg/cm^2. Processing not separately specified in this sensitivity panel; do not infer it from adjacent MTF graph. Use relative spectral shape only.

paper_graph.identity: NEW MULTIGRADE RC DELUXE & PORTFOLIO (fifth generation), filter 2; second steepest curve in the 00,0,1,2,3 panel
paper_graph.conditions: MULTIGRADE developer 1+9, 1 minute at 20 C; intermittent agitation per processing summary on page 4. Surface not identified by the graph; no surface-specific or texture claim.
paper_graph.trace_method: Manual centreline clicks on the original embedded raster. Grade 2 is second from left above the crossover and second from right in the toe. Merged strokes are ambiguous by roughly 2-3 pixels. Shared plateaus traced as shared, not separate measurements.

film.name: Kodak Tri-X 400 (experimental)
film.base_density_note: Estimated asymptote just below the lowest plotted total density (about 0.288); separated once from net density. Not a separately measured film-base spectrum.
film.exposure_origin_note: Rendering convention: shift source exposure so net density 0.75 occurs at engine log exposure zero, matching the existing Double-X default anchor. This does not implement absolute ISO exposure metering.
film.sensitivity_note: PCHIP of the labelled solid log-sensitivity trace; engine covers 380-780 nm. Truncate beyond 665 nm because the plot reaches its lower limit near 668 nm. This is an explicit unmeasured-tail approximation, not proof of zero red sensitivity.

paper.name: Ilford Multigrade RC Deluxe Grade 2 (experimental)
paper.sensitivity_note: Unit sensitivity on 380-550 nm, zero elsewhere: a neutral-negative integration weight, NOT a digitisation of the unscaled Ilford spectral plot. Cancels algebraically for spectrally neutral negatives under normalized print exposure. No calibrated colour-negative printing, absolute paper speed, spectral filtration, or continuously variable contrast claim.
paper.density_note: Published reflection density is used once: reflectance = 10^(-D). Neutral base and image spectrum assumed. No double-pass multiplier; no measured warm tint or paper-surface scattering.

sampling.method: Constrained positive normal-CDF mixture (four mathematical components for film, three for paper); fit source points plus a 0.3-weight PCHIP/continuation prior. Model is authoritative; sampled curves and sublayers generated coherently. No microscopic layer claim.
sampling.film_runtime_min_note: Runtime subtracts the minimum sampled film net density (about 0.0008 D) before development. This small offset is reported and included in source tolerance; base density is added once. The original source curve does not measure a shoulder.
